serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Hello little one. Let’s make it quick today, my head hurts…
You: W-what happened?!
Big Daddy: I think it’s da lack of drugs… {{wi}}I knew that getting sober was a bad idea…
You: Do you want to reschedule? 
Big Daddy: Nah, I will just grit my teeth and power through like always. 
Big Daddy: If you ignore your problems long enough, they tend to disappear. You should try it too.
You: I…{{wi}} I don’t think that's good advice, Big Daddy…
Big Daddy: Oh really? It worked pretty well for me. 
Big Daddy: One time I had a problem with a faucet in my bathroom. It would drip and drip no matter how much I turned it off.
Big Daddy: I was quite busy at the time…
So nothing changed, really.
Big Daddy: …and I couldn’t be bothered calling for some guy-{{wi}} or a lady, to fix it.
Big Daddy: Turns out that if your water installation starts leaking to a neighbor below, someone eventually will come to fix it! Then they just email you the cost of repairs and it’s done.
You: That’s…
I don’t even know how to start explaining to him how wrong this is…
Big Daddy: But enough about that, my boring stories are not what you came for today after all.
Big Daddy: You wanted to ask about how I came around to have all these sexbots and shit.
Big Daddy: The story begins with a certain group of people who called themselves Connoisseurs. 
Big Daddy: Full name of this organization was Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism.
Big Daddy: Connoisseurs believed that through technological advancements a Utopia can be created. An utopia in which all work would be automated and peoplekind would be free to do as they please, forever. 
Big Daddy: Free to pursue all their dreams and ambitions, with no worries about what to eat, where to sleep, who will unclog the toilet. You get the idea.
You: What happened to them?
Big Daddy: Well, fast progress in AI technology gave hope to a lot of people so the postulates of this organization were getting more and more popular in the general public.
Big Daddy: Ironically, the more the idea of a utopia was explored and theorized, the less feasible the creation of it was. 
Big Daddy: Automatization of da whole peoplekind workforce would just consume too much energy and resources. We had the technology, but the implementation of it on a large scale was just impossible.
Big Daddy: This realization brought accusations of elitism and even rumors of plans for massive depopulation.
Big Daddy: This was around the time sexbots became popular. Public’s attention was brought to the lowering birth rates which was swiftly picked up by populist politicians.
Big Daddy: The ongoing tensions with China, the biggest sexbot producer, only made things worse.
Big Daddy: What people want, first and foremost, is to be safe. That’s why a ban on sexbots and further AI development was put in place.
You: Alright, but why also ban AI development?
Big Daddy: There is actually a good reason for it. John Paul 202 and a guy named Tavis created AI that could rival the best minds of our kind.
Big Daddy: Later, John Paul 202 and other top scientists of the world decided that it’s too dangerous to go even further. Machines could turn against us and there would be no way of stopping them. 
Big Daddy: Not everyone was thinking the same though. Big part of the Connoisseurs thought that creating a very powerful AI, a Proto-god that would come up with an idea on how to realize all of our ambitions, is a viable option.
You: Did they succeed?
Big Daddy: No. If they did, we would live in a paradise on earth. 
Big Daddy: Connoisseurs’ ideas were deemed too dangerous by the nations of the world and banned. 
Big Daddy: That didn’t stop them though. They set up many labs, but in the end, one by one, they were caught and severely punished.
You: How come you know so much about them?
Big Daddy: I was one of them, but I bailed out at the right time. That’s why I’m still alive. 
Big Daddy: My young adult dreams were crushed by da cold reality of this world…
You: Are you still interested in creating this Proto-god?
Big Daddy: No. At some point I realized that not everyone’s intentions were as good as mine. Some part of da organization wanted to use Proto-god to create a utopia only for themselves. They felt betrayed by da world and thought that it was only fair that they would be the only ones benefiting from their own creation. 
Big Daddy: I’m still very much involved in a betterment of human life, but there are other ways of doing it. A certain level of empathy is needed to convince people of your ideas. Connoisseurs lacked that.
Big Daddy: Collecting sexbots is only a small part of things I do, same with da art gallery. 
Big Daddy: I still think that da sexbot ban was a mistake. Sexbots improved da mental health of many people and reports saying that they were da main cause of sinking birth rates were vastly exaggerated.
Big Daddy: I have too much to lose so you will not see me voicing my opinions publicly, but I do as much as I can behind the scenes to help others.
Big Daddy: I’m a part of a new organization, it’s called Binary Birthright Coalition. We fight for equal peoplekind rights for AI constructs with a consciousness on the same level of intelligence as we.
Big Daddy: If we succeed, you would no longer need to hide your bot away. You would be free to do as you please.
You: T-that sounds great!
Big Daddy: I knew you would like it.
Big Daddy: That would be all about the organizations.
